description: December 2020 and February 2021 boundary searches were conducted. Contemporary OKO.press confirms a Dec31 Warsaw protest remained physically present at midnight Jan1; its owner is poland_2020-12 and the continuation is recorded separately as POL202101-C001. Its post-midnight physical end and 50-person threshold remain unknown. February search/open leads include Feb1 Women’s Strike planning and search-only reports of later city protests, but do not establish Jan27–28 physical continuity or an exact national close.
required_followup: Keep the Dec31 protest in the December-owned continuation record, establish its threshold and physical end if accessible evidence is found, and seek contemporary departure/continuity evidence for the Jan27–28 actions. Do not infer continuity from campaign or weekly planning announcements.
